about: Data for /roadmap. Updates in release order; hour = hours after launch. LIVE badges come only from the public CHANGELOG.md (raw.githubusercontent.com/lemniscatedev/<publicRepo>/main/CHANGELOG.md), never from the clock. Empty publicRepo: no fetch, no LIVE badge. launchAt (ISO UTC) only turns "hour N after launch" into a date; it never marks anything live.

updates.title: Status page
updates.line: A public status page: service health, the age of every price and volatility input, and the market session.

updates.title: Holding cost over 7 and 30 days
updates.line: Every option shows what it costs to hold for 7 and 30 days at today's price, labelled as an estimate.

updates.title: Backup RPC connection
updates.line: A second RPC provider answers only when the official public RPC fails; traffic returns as soon as it is healthy.

updates.title: Earnings calendar
updates.line: Each stock shows its next report date and exactly when new buys pause around it, in your local time.

updates.title: Plain-language errors
updates.line: A failed transaction now says why in plain words, and whether your funds moved.

updates.title: Shield preview
updates.line: Before you add a Shield, compare protection at 5%, 10% and 15% below today's price and what each costs.

updates.title: Live quote stream
updates.line: The dashboard gets price changes pushed the moment the service sees them, with the regular refresh as a fallback.

updates.title: Writer Pool NAV history
updates.line: The Writer Pool tab charts NAV and NAV per share over 7, 30, 90 days or all time, plus funding received per day.

updates.title: Position history chart
updates.line: Each position has a History chart: its value and your effective units over time.

updates.title: API reference page
updates.line: A readable reference for the API at /v1/docs, built from the same OpenAPI spec the service publishes.

updates.title: Option chain export
updates.line: Download any listed name's whole option chain as CSV or JSON.

updates.title: Keeper batches sized from measured gas
updates.line: The keeper measures gas per option series and sends a smaller batch when 45 would not fit comfortably.

updates.title: Faster indexer catch-up
updates.line: After an interruption the indexer reads several chain ranges at once and applies them strictly in order.

updates.title: Activity filters and search
updates.line: Search and filter the Activity tab by name, kind, ticket, transaction and date range.

updates.title: Receipts lookup
updates.line: Paste a transaction hash and your browser checks the trade against the hourly Merkle root the API publishes.

updates.title: Volatility page
updates.line: Charts of the volatility input behind each stock's option prices, with the latest on-chain posts.

updates.title: Browser alerts (opt-in)
updates.line: Optional browser notifications for holding-cost jumps, market session changes and filled queued sells.

updates.title: API caching and rate-limit headers
updates.line: API responses show the remaining request allowance, and public reads send ETags for cheap repeat requests.

updates.title: Agent tools for volatility and receipts
updates.line: Two read-only MCP tools for agents: volatility posts and hourly receipts.

updates.title: Accessibility pass
updates.line: The whole site works from the keyboard and with screen readers, with easier-to-read small text.

updates.title: Breakeven on the chart
updates.line: The option chart draws today's price, the cost, the breakeven and where the option has paid for itself.

updates.title: Reorg-safety report
updates.line: The status page reports how the indexer handles chain reorganisations: how many, the deepest, and the last check.

updates.title: Dark mode
updates.line: Dark mode follows your device, with a toggle in the header remembered only in your browser.

updates.title: Monthly statements
updates.line: Pick a month and download your trades, deposits and month-end holdings as CSV, or print to PDF.

updates.title: TypeScript SDK
updates.line: A typed TypeScript library for the API, in the sdk/ folder of the public repo (not on npm).

updates.title: Faster first load on phones
updates.line: The first screen waits only for what you can see; the home page needs about 1.0 MB instead of 2.1 MB to be ready.

updates.title: Stricter security headers
updates.line: Stricter security headers and a content security policy on the site and the API.

updates.title: Hedge transparency
updates.line: A Hedges page: what the Writer Pool holds per stock, the target, and a log of hedge fills.

updates.title: Leaner accrual keeper
updates.line: The keeper stops re-reading strikes nobody holds for up to 30 minutes; any trade is noticed at once.

updates.title: Agent activity page
updates.line: A public page of every agent trade through the AgentRouter and every active agent policy.

updates.title: Your options, on every device
updates.line: The Activity tab lists every option your wallet bought, sold or holds, read from the chain, on any device.

updates.title: Public stats page
updates.line: Daily volume, trades, wallets and open interest, each figure with its on-chain source and time.

updates.title: Daily vs Weekly compare
updates.line: Daily and Weekly side by side for the same strike: price, sell price and holding cost over 7 and 30 days.

updates.title: Holding-cost history
updates.line: Per option and per day: the share of units funding took and its USDG value, from on-chain accruals.

updates.title: Writer Pool depositor view
updates.line: Depositors see their shares, value at the latest NAV per share, totals, a daily NAV chart and claim tickets.

updates.title: Open interest by strike
updates.line: For each stock, how many call and put units holders hold at every strike, with the latest price marked.

updates.title: Stock listings
updates.line: What trades today and which Stock Tokens could be next, read on chain.

updates.title: New stocks switch on by themselves
updates.line: AMZN, MSFT, GOOGL, MSTR and META are queued and switch on once listed on chain.

updates.title: Price feed history
updates.line: When each stock's Chainlink feed last updated, the gaps and each move.

updates.title: The buy check, in public
updates.line: Feed price against the Uniswap 30-minute average, the gap and pass or fail.

updates.title: Funding rates board
updates.line: What staying open cost over 24 hours on every option, like a perps funding board.

updates.title: Exposure per option
updates.line: Stock exposure per USDG of premium, leverage-equivalent, and the move to double.

updates.title: Large trades feed
updates.line: Every buy and sell above your size in the last 1 to 168 hours.

updates.title: Most traded options
updates.line: The top options by USDG volume over 24 hours or 7 days.

updates.title: Portfolio Greeks
updates.line: Delta, gamma, vega and daily funding per position, per stock and in total.

updates.title: Market calendar
updates.line: The next 14 days of sessions, holidays, early closes and earnings pauses.

updates.title: Daily digest
updates.line: Yesterday in one call: trades, volume, wallets, new options and the pool.

updates.title: Realised vs posted volatility
updates.line: How much each stock really moved next to the volatility options are priced at.

updates.title: Writer Pool utilisation
updates.line: Option liability as a share of the pool's NAV at each day's close.

updates.title: Agent tools
updates.line: Three read-only MCP tools: listings, calendar and the daily digest.

updates.title: Account summary
updates.line: One small call per wallet for bots: options, value, cost, P&L and pool share.

updates.title: Network fee estimator
updates.line: Buy, sell, deposit and claim fees in ETH and USD at the current gas price.

updates.title: Indexer lag history
updates.line: 24 hours of how far the indexer was behind the chain, every 5 minutes.

updates.title: Series search
updates.line: Filter every live option by stock, speed, side, strike range and buyable.

updates.title: P&L scenario simulator
updates.line: Pick an option, a sale price and days held: what you pay, units left and the floor value.

updates.title: Break-even moves
updates.line: For every strike, the move needed after 1, 7 or 30 days of funding, and exposure per dollar.

updates.title: Glossary
updates.line: Every term the site uses in plain words, searchable, each linked to where it appears.

updates.title: Market hours
updates.line: When the US market is open, in your own time zone, and the live session of every stock.

updates.title: Command palette
updates.line: Ctrl+K or Cmd+K on any page to jump to every page by name.

updates.title: Watchlist
updates.line: Star a stock to keep it at the top of the list, saved in this browser only.

updates.title: Budget planner
updates.line: Units a USDG budget buys per strike, units left after funding and the break-even then.

updates.title: Cost ladder
updates.line: Every strike at Daily and Weekly, coloured by the share of value funding takes per day.

updates.title: Share image
updates.line: A clean picture of a position for X or Telegram, change in percent only.

updates.title: Pair builder
updates.line: An Up call and a Down put together: total price, daily cost and both break-evens.

updates.title: Status light in the nav
updates.line: Live, Delayed or Service issue on every page, checked every minute.

updates.title: Writer Pool calculator
updates.line: Shares a deposit buys at today's NAV per share, your share of the pool and NAV scenarios.

updates.title: Follow updates feed
updates.line: An Atom feed of every released update, linked on the roadmap.

updates.title: How it works
updates.line: Lemniscate in six steps on one printable page.

updates.title: Device clock check
updates.line: The app warns when your device clock is off, before a signature fails.

updates.title: Every stock in one call
updates.line: A new /v1/names endpoint: price, session and series counts for every stock.

updates.title: Sitemap and robots
updates.line: A sitemap and robots.txt for every page, kept in step with each build.

updates.title: Uptime and last deploy
updates.line: Service uptime and the last deploy time on the status page and in /v1/health.
